t: You're on Cleveland Street, which runs from Euston Road down to the junction of Mortimer Street and Goodge Street, through Fitzrovia. It also marks part of the border between Camden and Westminster. In the seventeenth century it was a rural way known as Green Lane, or Wrastling Lane, after a nearby amphitheatre for boxing and wrestling. The present name comes from Charles FitzRoy, 2nd Duke of Cleveland, an illegitimate son of Charles II, who inherited the title from his mother.
